009import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;

017
018public class SimUpdateIntel extends FleetLogIntel {
019
020        protected LinkedHashSet<String> addedFactions;
021        protected LinkedHashSet<String> addedVariants;
022
023        public SimUpdateIntel(LinkedHashSet<String> addedFactions, LinkedHashSet<String> addedVariants) {
024                this.addedFactions = addedFactions;
025                this.addedVariants = addedVariants;
026                
027                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this);
028        }
029
030        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode, boolean isUpdate, Color tc, float initPad) {
031                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
032                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
033                float pad = 3f;
034                float opad = 10f;
035                
036                bullet(info);
037                
038                if (!addedFactions.isEmpty()) {
039                        String factions = addedFactions.size() == 1 ? "faction" : "factions";
040                        info.addPara("%s new " + factions + "", initPad, tc, h, "" + addedFactions.size());
041                        initPad = 0f;
042                }
043                if (!addedVariants.isEmpty()) {
044                        String variants = addedVariants.size() == 1 ? "variant" : "variants";
045                        info.addPara("%s new hull " + variants + "", initPad, tc, h, "" + addedVariants.size());
046                        initPad = 0f;
047                }
048                unindent(info);
049        }
050
051        @Override
052        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
053                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
054                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
055                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
056                float pad = 3f;
057                float small = 3f;
058                float opad = 10f;
059
060//              info.addPara("New simulator opponents and factions unlocked. New ships "
061//                              + "are unlocked by encountering and destroying them in battle.", 0f);
062                
063                if (!addedFactions.isEmpty()) {
064                        info.addSpacer(0f);
065                        info.addSectionHeading("Factions", Alignment.MID, opad);
066                        info.addPara("New simulator factions available. New factions "
067                                        + "are made available by encountering their fleets, or deserters from the faction, in battle.", opad);
068                        //bullet(info);
069                        float initPad = opad;
070                        for (String fid : addedFactions) {
071                                FactionSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getFactionSpec(fid);
072                                TooltipMakerAPI para = info.beginImageWithText(spec.getCrest(), 32);
073                                para.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(spec.getDisplayName()), spec.getBaseUIColor(), 0f);
074                                //para.getPosition().setXAlignOffset(100f);
075                                info.addImageWithText(initPad);
076                                //info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(spec.getDisplayName()), spec.getBaseUIColor(), initPad);
077                                initPad = 3f;
078                        }
079                        //unindent(info);
080                }
081                
082                if (!addedVariants.isEmpty()) {
083                        info.addSpacer(0f);
084                        float extra = 0f;
085                        if (!addedFactions.isEmpty()) extra = 2f;
086                        info.addSectionHeading("Ship variants", Alignment.MID, opad + extra);
087                        info.addPara("New simulator opponents available. New ships "
088                                                + "are made available by encountering and destroying them in battle.", opad);
089                        
090                        List<FleetMemberAPI> members = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
091                        for (String vid : addedVariants) {
092                                FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, vid);
093                                members.add(member);
094                        }
095                        
096                        int cols = 7;
097                        float iconSize = width / cols;
098                        int rows = members.size() / cols;
099                        if (rows * cols < members.size()) rows++;
100                        info.addShipList(cols, rows, iconSize, Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), members, opad);
101                        
102                        //info.showShips(members, members.size(), true, opad);
103//                      bullet(info);
104//                      float initPad = opad;
105//                      for (String vid : addedVariants) {
106//                              ShipVariantAPI v = Global.getSettings().getVariant(vid);
107//                              if (v == null) continue;
108//                              info.addPara(v.getFullDesignationWithHullName(), initPad);
109//                              initPad = 0f;
110//                      }
111//                      unindent(info);
112                }
113                
114                addLogTimestamp(info, tc, opad);
115                
116                addDeleteButton(info, width);
117        }
118
119        @Override
120        public String getIcon() {
121                return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel", "simulator_update");
122        }
123
124        @Override
125        public Set<String> getIntelTags(SectorMapAPI map) {
126                Set<String> tags = super.getIntelTags(map);
127                return tags;
128        }
129
130        public String getName() {
131                return "Simulator Update";
132        }
133
134}
